568:t_1:10.en:
$$マリ$$
「Oh! Look how surprised he is!」

568:t_1:16.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Is it because... I wished I could do something... about this world...?)

568:t_2:5.en:
$$レイアム$$
「So you're refusing to tell us about the situation?」

568:t_2:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I'm not refusing anything. I don't know why $c was sent to this world, either.」

568:t_2:7.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$, do you have any idea?」

568:t_2:9.en:
$n
「After your EVA shone in that space that looked like another dimension, we were sent here.」

568:t_2:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Anything will do. If you know something, please tell us.」

568:t_2:13.en:
$$デュオ$$
「For now, they say there's not a single intact building anywhere around us.」

568:t_2:14.en:
$$カトル$$
「If this is the world $$シンジ$$ and the others came from, I think we should go to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ first and find out what's happening.」

568:t_2:17.en:
$$青山$$
「Then what do you expect us to do?」

568:t_2:18.en:
$$いぶき$$
「That's right, $$シンジ$$. Do you know anyone else we can turn to?」

568:t_2:20.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I finally got to see Big Sis again, and now this happens...」

568:t_2:21.en:
$$カズミ$$
「There's no time to get discouraged, $$ノリコ$$. We need to stay calm at times like this.」

568:t_2:24.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You must be $$ノノ$$. $$ノリコ$$ has told me the basics.」

568:t_2:25.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'm $$オオタ・カズミ$$, the pilot of $$バスターマシン２号$$.」

568:t_2:26.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We're fellow $$バスターマシン$$ pilots... Though you're actually a $$バスターマシン$$ yourself. Will you be my friend?」

568:t_2:28.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I'm looking forward to knowing you. ...May I call you $$ノノ$$?」

568:t_2:30.en:
$$チコ$$
「What's this, $$ノノ$$...? Are you planning to switch Big Sisters?」

568:t_2:31.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What are you saying, $$チコ$$!? $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis will forever...」

568:t_2:33.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't know what happened between you and Princess, but hurry up and make up with her.」

568:t_2:34.en:
$$チコ$$
「I don't want the $$バラの女王$$ saying our $$バスターマシン$$ pilots have no spirit.」

568:t_2:37.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't worry, Big Sis. $$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are the best team after you and me.」

568:t_2:38.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It's that boy over there I'm worried about.」

568:t_2:40.en:
$$カズミ$$
(I know, because my own wish took shape... His unbalanced emotions brought us here...)

568:t_2:41.en:
$$レイアム$$
「...I'd like you to cooperate a little more with our questions. We must find a way back to our own world, no matter what.」

568:t_2:43.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「XO $$レイアム$$. They say they can't establish communications with $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.」

568:t_2:44.en:
$$レイアム$$
「There may be some kind of trouble, or they're refusing to respond...」

568:t_2:45.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「The captains are considering heading to Japan to find out what's happening.」

568:t_2:46.en:
$$レイアム$$
「That would be the surest way.」

568:t_2:47.en:
$$マリ$$
(I never thought we'd end up going to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ like this...)

568:t_2:48.en:
$$アスカ$$
(Depending on what happens, we may have to finish what we started in $$セントラルドグマ$$...)

568:t_2:51.en:
$$カヲル$$
「This return is only temporary. ...Isn't that right, $$シンジ$$?」

568:t_2:53.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The question is whether we'll stay safe until then.」

568:t_2:54.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「XO $$レイアム$$! Unidentified units are approaching this area!」

568:t_2:55.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Everyone, return to your ships!」

568:t_2:58.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$. They've reached into this world, too.」

568:t_3:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

568:t_3:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...I understand you have your own troubles, too. I'm sorry I treated you like a spoiled rich kid who's never suffered.」

568:t_3:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「...You've beaten me completely. You're far more mature than I am.」

568:t_3:9.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Are you accepting that you'll grow up?」

568:t_3:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If I get as hung up on it as $$カシオ$$, it'll be hard to rejoin society.」

568:t_3:11.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Like Captain $$アムロ$$ said, I'll find my own way to become strong as an adult.」

568:t_3:12.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'll still fight as a $$トップレス$$ until I reach $$あがり$$, though.」

568:t_3:14.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Haha... Now I'm even getting encouragement from you.」

568:t_3:15.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I-I'm sorry...! That sounded so arrogant!」
